why_5: Experience that brings confidence to the decision

ab_h1: 15+ years in HR systems and recruitment.
ab_lead: Pioneers of digital recruitment in Montenegro - through the first online job portal, zaposli.me. Today we help companies build teams that deliver.
ab_founder_p:
Master of Economics specializing in Human Resources.
Lecturer in Human Resources Management at the University of Donja Gorica and a UDG alumnus. Co-founder and long-time CEO of zaposli.me - Montenegro's pioneering online job portal - which he founded, grew and successfully exited. Career record: Over 1,000 job interviews and hundreds of successful placements.
tr_cw_s: International credit rating agency Company Wall · certificate CWB-26-69383
tr_fond: Backed by the Innovation Fund of Montenegro
pn_h2: Tools that give our clients an edge
pn_p: We choose partners who make our assessment more objective - and your hiring process faster and more cost-effective.
pn1_p: We are an official partner of the Recrewty platform. At the client's request, shortlisted candidates take psychometric tests - an objective, science-based layer of personality and ability assessment that complements our reports and further reduces the risk of a wrong hire.
pn2_p: We partner with tvojtim.me - a new-generation HR platform for job advertising and application management. As our client, you get a 10% discount on advertising on the platform.
ms_p: We connect human capital with proven leaders in their industries - helping individuals and teams grow.
vs_p: To be the place where technology and human capital meet - a consultancy that, through unwavering commitment, sets the standard for human resource management in Montenegro and world wide.
pr_p:
Our work rests on a philosophy of creative adaptation: the world of work keeps changing, and we change with it - fast in decisions, consistent in values.
We believe human capital is the foundation of every business, and that success must never come at people's expense. That is why we build learning centres, not hierarchies - and treat every engagement with the care of a good steward.
pv1_p: For every challenge we look for the angle others don't see - solutions tailored to the client, not to a template.
pv2_p: The highest ethical standards at every step of the process - towards clients, candidates and the market.
pv3_p: Clear, open and timely communication - no fine print, no hidden steps.

ab_v4: Experience from both practice and academia

em_h1: Tell us who you're looking for - we'll handle the rest.
em_lead: The role-profiling questionnaire - we guide you step by step, with a live completion tracker. Set aside about 15 minutes: the more precise your answers, the better the candidate we present to you.
em_consent: I agree to the processing of my data for contact and engagement preparation.
wz_note: Your answers remain strictly with the Hirin' Hero agency and are used solely for profiling purposes - they are never shared with third parties in any form.
eq_na: For questions that don't fit your engagement, simply answer "N/A". The more detailed your answers - the better the selection.
eq1: 1. Do you have specific preferences for this role (gender, years of experience, background in a particular industry or company, from Montenegro, the region or abroad)?
eq2: 2. What key character traits are you looking for in a candidate for this role?
eq3: 3. What key technical skills are you looking for in a candidate for this role?
eq4: 4. Working hours, daily and weekly? Is the role off during national and/or religious holidays?
eq5: 5. How many people will this candidate work with? Who will they report to?
eq6: 6. Is this a newly opened position, or a vacancy that needs to be filled?
eq7: 7. If we find someone from the region, or an expat in Montenegro, would you be willing to compensate part of the salary by covering their housing for the duration of the contract?
eq8: 8. The key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) of this role?
eq9: 9. What non-material benefits does this role carry? (e.g. training, mentoring, paid meals, paid commute, education, scholarship, learning an additional foreign language)
eq10: 10. Is the role strictly salary-based (fixed monthly pay), or is there a bonus scheme or a percentage share in realized business?
eq11: 11. Roughly how long does it take this person to move up the company hierarchy - or to progress financially in a noticeable way?
eq12: 12. What does this person need to do in order to advance within that timeframe?
eq13: 13. What is, for you, a "red card" - grounds for dismissing an employee?
eq14: 14. Describe your company culture in a few strokes (up to 4 sentences).
eq14_h: Hint: company culture essentially answers the question - why do I work here and not somewhere else?
eq15: 15. What is the average tenure of employees at your company (time with you, not total experience)?
eq16: 16. Briefly describe the onboarding process for this role - timeline and phases.
eq17: 17. Contract duration for this role? How is the probation period defined?
eq18: 18. Insurance type - is the candidate insured on the full monthly salary, or would part of it be paid in cash?
eq19: 19. Net monthly salary for this role?
eq20: 20. Is there a bonus scheme or a simple bonus for this role?
eq21: 21. Timeline for finding and engaging this person?
eq22: 22. Name one key, essential reason why this candidate should leave their current job to work for you.
em_done: Your questionnaire has been sent. We'll get back to you shortly with a proposed consultation slot and next steps.
ca_h1:
Apply.
We'll find the right opportunity for you.
ca_lead: The profiling questionnaire - step by step, with a live completion tracker. Set aside about 15 minutes: the more precise your answers, the better our chances of finding the right opportunity for you.
cq1: What are your key professional skills?
cq2: Which industries do you have experience in, and for how long (e.g. May 2018 – June 2020)?
cq3: How many years of work experience do you have in total?
cq4: Do you prefer working in large corporations, mid-sized companies or small businesses? Why?
cq5: Would you rather work in a team or independently?
cq6: Do you prefer office work, remote work, or a hybrid model?
cq7: How would you describe your ideal employer (e.g. stability, culture, room to grow)?
cq7_h: Let your imagination run free - we know the ideal employer probably doesn't exist, but the point is to get as close as possible to your picture of one.
cq8: What are your fields of interest at work (e.g. finance, sales, IT, marketing, HR)?
cq9: What types of work would you absolutely not want to do?
cq10: Would you be open to changing your current industry? If yes, which industry attracts you?
cq11: What are your short-term (within the next year) and long-term (5+ years) career goals?
cq12: What motivates you most at work (e.g. financial stability, advancement, challenges, a good team, a mentoring manager)?
cq13: What work–life balance do you prefer?
cq14: Is the possibility of training and developing new skills at work important to you?
cq15: What net monthly salary do you expect (range from–to)?
cq16: Would you be willing to work overtime or on weekends when needed?
cq17: Do you have preferences regarding work location (e.g. a specific city, part of town, work from home)?
cq18: Which technologies, software or tools do you regularly use in your work?
cq19: Would you be willing to learn new technologies and/or tools? If yes, which ones exactly?
cq20: Is there anything specific an employer should know about you in order to offer you the best opportunity?
